runtime_hypothesis.description: On positive actual HP loss, Bittercake applies its DEF buff after actor HP has been settled, including when that loss is fatal. The first trigger is ready at time zero, suppression does not move the cooldown, and the cooldown starts on successful activation. Buff expiry precedes equal-time events; same-time incoming damage precedes later dynamically queued hit deliveries. Native text establishes damage received, duration and cooldown, but not trigger readiness, fatal-hit activation or exact same-time ordering.
limitations: Incoming damage is an explicit request/CLI fixture input; there is no enemy AI, mitigation, or DSL authoring in this checkpoint.
Admitted NativeDirect packets are cancelled with a trace if their owner dies before delivery. Postmortem owner-child/research-declared packet semantics are rejected as unsupported.
The frozen description does not establish fatal-hit activation or exact same-time ordering; the tested hypothesis above is used.
Release availability is not verified by these native tables.

incoming_damage_model.description: Explicit actor-damage events represent already-delivered nonnegative damage after mitigation. At a timestamp, action admissions run before incoming damage; incoming events run before dynamically queued direct hit deliveries. Timed buffs expire before events at their deadline. Ordinary shields absorb first, followed by reached owner-specific overflow absorption; HP loss is min(residual damage, current HP), overkill is the remaining residual, and damage to a defeated actor settles as zero HP loss with all delivered damage reported as overflow. Admitted NativeDirect packets are cancelled with a trace when their owner is defeated before delivery; other postmortem packet ownership remains unsupported. This is a fixture settlement model and does not model enemy damage mitigation or AI.
limits: The model assumption is required for every request containing incoming_damage_events.
Switching to a defeated actor is rejected; a defeated active actor can switch to a living teammate.
